investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Orbhollow Games (online gaming); Platform: Microsoft Azure southeastasia (zones southeastasia-1/southeastasia-2/southeastasia-3); network range 10.193.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster orbhol-prod-southe (AKS); Database: mysql instance matchmaking-db-01 for matchmaking-svc; Deployments: Helm releases rolled out by a CI release bot after human approval; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
